user.title: Connect Babycam to go2rtc
user.description: Babycam relays each card's WebRTC signaling to a go2rtc server — typically the one built into Frigate or Home Assistant's go2rtc add-on. Enter that server's WebSocket base address.

data_description.url: ws:// for a server on your network (ws://frigate:1984), or wss:// including any path prefix when go2rtc sits behind a reverse proxy (wss://cctv.example.com/live/webrtc).

data.dev_mode: Developer mode (serve card live from disk)

data_description.url: The go2rtc server Babycam relays WebRTC signaling to (e.g. ws://frigate:1984, or wss://cctv.example.com/live/webrtc behind a reverse proxy).
data_description.ice_servers: JSON list of RTCIceServer entries used by every card unless the card sets its own ice_servers. Add a TURN server on TCP port 443 (urls scheme turns:, plus username and credential) to keep remote streams working on restrictive networks. Clearing the field restores the default STUN entry shown here.
data_description.dev_mode: Card file edits appear on a browser reload without restarting Home Assistant. Leave off in production so the card and backend only change together at restart.
